Attendance

Mark the daily attendance for your class.

Choose a date, then mark each student as Present, Late, Absent, or Excused. Changes are saved in this browser when you click Save Attendance.

Report filters

DepEd SF2 — Learner’s Daily Attendance Report

Student attendance

Generate a month-based, landscape printout from saved student attendance. Review the output against the latest school-approved DepEd SF2 form before using it as an official record.

Code key in this printout: P = Present, A = Absent, L = Late, E = Excused, — = no saved mark. Only saved attendance marks are included.

Backup your data

Download a JSON backup containing your student list, attendance records, and settings. Keep it somewhere safe.

Restoring replaces the data currently stored in this browser.

Data tools

Clear all local data

This permanently deletes all students, attendance records, and saved settings from this browser. Download a backup first if you need to keep your data.

Acknowledgment note

SchoolTrack is an attendance-recording tool prepared for use at Mayuga National High School. Developer: Joshua B. Condes. Please verify attendance entries for accuracy and keep regular backups. This browser-only version stores data on the current device and does not automatically sync to other phones or computers.
